title: 第12章 不理解
novel_title: 恶毒女配又装纯，禁欲大佬皆沦陷
content_zh:
和铃在后面排起了队。

    第五齐原本想离开的，但和铃不想走，他只好陪着她一块排队。

    说实话，他也不放心自己离开，把和铃丢在这里。

    毕竟一尘峰的几个讨厌鬼也在。

    他要是不看着点和铃，以和铃的脑子，恐怕又要被骗了。

    轮到和铃到了玄墨麒麟的跟前，她从储物戒中取出一株长有五节，通体翠绿，没有叶子的灵植。

    旁边的人窃窃私语。

    “这是三阶翠节草吧？和铃师姐真是财大气粗，这么好的灵植就拿来喂小麒麟了。”

    “三阶灵植而已，对和铃师姐来说算得了什么？以她的修为，采几株翠节草回来，还不是轻而易举的事情。”

    “要我说，要不是和铃师姐成日里就跟在夜师兄的后面跑，荒废了修行，她的修为肯定比现在还高。”

    舔狗系统听了想笑。

    和铃什么资质它还不清楚？

    她不跟在夜弦身后才是荒废修为呢！

    和铃将翠节草放到小麒麟嘴边，小麒麟眼睛微微一亮，低头去咬，结果和铃扬手把翠节草收回来。

    小麒麟大大的眼睛里透露着不解。

    不是给它的吗？

    和铃微笑说道：“我是混元峰明瑟真君的亲传弟子，和铃。七日后的神兽认主仪式，你要是答应跟我，这种三阶灵草想要多少有多少。”

    见小麒麟耳朵动了动，把她的话听进去了，和铃这才把翠节草送到它嘴边。

    “等等和铃！你不能喂小麒麟翠节草！”

    人群中响起一道声音。

    和铃和小麒麟扭头看去，只见一名身穿淡黄流仙裙的女子快步走来。

    她微微挑眉，舔狗系统提醒道：【这是夜弦的二师姐，金蕊。】

    金蕊来到和铃跟前，亲切地喊她：“阿铃，你答应过我要把翠节草送我的。”

    旁边的第五齐面无表情。

    他这个师妹做散财童子做惯了，金蕊既然提出此事，多半是真的。

    在第五齐眼中，没有比和铃更胳膊肘往外拐的人了。
content_en:
He Ling lined up at the back.

Wu Qi originally wanted to leave, but He Ling didn't want to leave, so he had to queue up with her.

To be honest, he didn't trust himself to leave and leave He Ling here.

After all, a few annoying people from Yichen Peak are also here.

If he hadn't looked at Dian Heling and Yi Heling's mind, he might have been deceived again.

It was He Ling's turn to arrive in front of Xuan Mo Qilin. She took out a five-node, green, leafless spiritual plant from her storage ring.

The people nearby whispered.

"Is this the third-level green grass? Senior Sister Heling is really rich. She feeds the little Qilin such a good spiritual plant."

"It's just a third-level spiritual plant, what does it mean to Senior Sister Heling? With her cultivation level, it is not easy to pick up a few green knotweeds."

"Let me tell you, if Senior Sister Heling hadn't been running behind Senior Brother Ye all day long, wasting her practice, her cultivation level would definitely be higher than it is now."

Licking System wanted to laugh after hearing this.

It’s not clear what qualifications Heling has?

If she doesn't follow Ye Xian, her cultivation will be wasted!

He Ling put the green knot grass to Xiao Qilin's mouth. Little Qilin's eyes lit up slightly, and he lowered his head to bite. As a result, He Ling raised his hand and took back the green knot grass.

Little Qilin's big eyes revealed confusion.

Isn't it meant for it?

He Ling smiled and said: "I am He Ling, the direct disciple of True Lord Mingse of Hunyuan Peak. In the ceremony of recognizing the master of the divine beast in seven days, if you agree to follow me, I can have as many third-level spiritual grasses as you want."

Seeing that the little Qilin's ears moved and he listened to her words, He Ling brought the green knotweed to its mouth.

"Wait a minute and Ling! You can't feed the little unicorn green grass!"

A voice sounded from the crowd.

He Ling and Xiao Qilin turned around and saw a woman wearing a light yellow flowing fairy skirt walking quickly.

She raised her eyebrows slightly, and the Lick Dog System reminded: [This is Ye Xian's second senior sister, Jin Rui.】

Jin Rui came to He Ling and called her affectionately: "A Ling, you promised me that you would give me the green knot grass."

The fifth Qi next to him had an expressionless face.

As a junior sister, he was used to being a money-splitting boy. Since Jin Rui raised this matter, it was probably true.

In Wu Qi's eyes, there is no one with more elbows turned out than He Ling.
